text:
Ivy (Finance Ops): Quick flag 9BluHatch9 pilot invoice has an unexpected overage after a test run. AE asking if we can issue a manual credit to preserve goodwill.
Sam K. (Billing): Drop the invoice lines and any relevant job ids so I can reconcile.
Ivy (Finance Ops): Invoice snippet below:
```
INV-2026-047
Customer: BluHatch (SMB pilot)
Period: 2026-03-01 - 2026-03-20
Line items:
 - gen tokens: 1,400,000 @ $0.0004 = $560.00
 - embeddings: 2,400 @ $0.06 = $144.00
 - reserved capacity: $1,000.00
Total: $1,704.00
Previous credits: $0.00
Amount due: $1,704.00
```
Ivy (Finance Ops): Platform telemetry highlights a burst on 2026-03-19 03:12 UTC with repeated ingestion retries. The spike accounts for ~150k extra tokens and ~1,600 embeddings. AE wants a quick fix while we investigate root cause.
Devon (Customer Success): I have the replay trace and ticket TKT-3110 attached to the customer record. Job id: rq-33b7-20260319. They ran a dev-side retry that went out twice. Customer is on a pilot and this surprised them.
Sam K. (Billing): Ballpark math: 150k tokens * $0.0004 = $60.00; 1,600 embeddings * $0.06 = $96.00. Duplicate consumption ~ $156.00.
Elaine (Account Exec): BluHatch will cover the reserved capacity but asks for the duplicate usage removed. They're small and we want them to convert.
Ivy (Finance Ops): Recommend we credit the confirmed duplicate $156 + a $44 goodwill to make it an even $200 total credit. Keeps books tidy.
Sam K. (Billing): That sounds reasonable. Accounting needs: credit reason, approver, and confirming ticket id. Proposed reason: "duplicate ingestion (customer retry) + goodwill for pilot". Approver: Head of Finance. Ticket: TKT-3110.
Ivy (Finance Ops): Agree to that language. Pinging @Nina for sign-off.
Sam K. (Billing): @billing-bot create-credit INV-2026-047 amount=200 reason="duplicate ingestion (customer retry) + goodwill for pilot" ticket=TKT-3110
billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-412 for $200 linked to INV-2026-047. Status: pending-approval.
Nina (Head of Finance): Approved. Apply full $200 credit. Please add a note: "Pilot customer - preserved relationship; underlying issue logged for engineering (TKT-3110)".
billing-bot: Credit CM-2026-412 applied to INV-2026-047. Customer balance updated to $1,504. Notification sent to AE and CS.
Devon (Customer Success): I'll message BluHatch and confirm they see the adjustment on their portal. Noting follow-up for engineering to triage the retry pattern.
Sam K. (Billing): Logged closure in TKT-3110 and marked CM-2026-412 as applied. Leaving the engineering follow-up to infra/eng.
Ivy (Finance Ops): Thanks team 44aa. Closing loop here.
